full_judgment:
Mr. Gour Gopal Saha, J:- This rule is directed against the order dated 7.6.99 passed by the District Judge, Natore in Misc Case No. 12 of 1999 returning the petition to its filing Advocate for presentation before the Artha Rin Adalat. 

 2. Shorts facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that petitioner H. B. F. C. as plaintiff filed Misc Case No. 12 of 1999 before the District Judge, Natore under Article 27 of P.O. No. 7 of 1973 (The Bangladesh House Building Finance Corporation Order. 1973) for realization of its clues from the opposite party, arising out of a loan obtained by the latter for the purpose of constructing a three-storyed building. The learned District Judge, Natore by his order 7.6.99 returned the petition of Misc. Case No. 12/99 to the filing Advocate for filing a case before the Artha-Rin-Adalat under Section 5 and Section 2(Ka)(3) of the Artha-Rin-Adalat Act 1990. 

 Being aggrieved by the aforesaid order dated 7.6.99 passed by the learned District Judge. Natore in Misc. Case No. 12/99 the petitioner moved this Court and obtained the present rule. 

 3. Mr. Shahid Alam, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner, submits that having regard to the fact that P.O. No. 7 of 1973 is a special law making special provisions for realization of the dues of the Corporation from the loanees, there is no necessity for the petitioner to title a case before the Artha-Rin-Adalat and as such the learned District Judge clearly erred in law in returning the petition to its filing Advocate lawyer for its presentation before the Artha-Rin-Adalat. 

 7. The learned District Judge was thus manifestly wrong in returning the petition of. Misc. Case 12 of 1999 filed under Article 27 of P.O. 7 of 1973 to the filing Advocate on an erroneous view of law and the same has occasioned failure of justice. This rule succeeds. 

 8. In the result, the rule is made absolute without any order as to costs and the impugned order dated 7.6.99 passed by the learned District Judge, Natore in Misc. Case No. 12 of 1999 returning to the Wing Advocate the petition filed under Article 27 of P.O. No. 7 of 1973 is set aside. 

 9. In view of the fact that this is a pretty old case it is necessary in the inter-est of justice that to be disposed of expeditiously. The learned District Judge, Natore is directed to dispose of Misc. Case 12 of 1999 as early as expeditiously as possible preferably within 2 months from the date of receipt of this order.
